_meta.description: Key-value store of arbitrary configs for the crunch_time branch. Each top-level key is a config name; its value is free-form JSON, shaped however that config needs. Added to as needed, not pre-planned.

parallelDispatch.description: Dispatch policy for background worktree agents on this branch.
parallelDispatch.maxParallelWorktreesNote: null = unlimited. Claude creates as many isolated worktrees as a task genuinely decomposes into, without asking first.
parallelDispatch.backgroundNote: Agents run in background mode by default (the Agent tool's standing default) and keep going independent of whether this conversation is active. Continuation of the orchestrating session itself across a full close/restart is the owner's responsibility (e.g. og-watchdog, #666, already covers this repo generally) — not something configurable from inside a conversation.

alerting.rule: Event-driven only, never polling. Claude sends a PushNotification and/or posts to Notice Board #224 the moment something needs owner attention (blocked decision, security finding, or a release actually finished) — never sits and checks.
alerting.dashboardNote: The Crunch Time artifact reflects live status for when the owner chooses to look, but is a pull channel, not itself an alert.
alerting.consideredAndRejected: Paperclip (~/.paperclip) — no confirmed alerting API, looks like Trace's own multi-agent build pipeline, not a notification system. Revisit only if the owner confirms it has a real hook.
